title: Diffusion-Based Geometric Graph Synthesis under Topological Invariants: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Synthesizing non-Euclidean graphs with specific topological constraints is non-trivial for standard diffusion. We design an SE(3)-equivariant score-based diffusion model conditioned on persistent homology features. Our approach generates valid molecular graphs with 94.6% validity and an 82% reduction in unphysical steric clashes. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 4.2x and a verified task accuracy of 94.6% with mean execution latency of 12.0ms.
